records.evidence_job: Explain, compare, or justify the target idea using the scenario evidence without changing the stated frame, quantity, or representation.

records.intended_reasoning: Explain, compare, or justify the target idea using the scenario evidence without changing the stated frame, quantity, or representation.
records.student_text: A skateboarder moves east while slowing down. State the direction of the skateboarder’s velocity and acceleration, and explain why the skateboarder is accelerating even though speed decreases.
records.student_html: A skateboarder moves east while slowing down. State the direction of the skateboarder’s velocity and acceleration, and explain why the skateboarder is accelerating even though speed decreases.
records.answer: Velocity is east; acceleration is west. Acceleration is any change in velocity, including a decrease in speed.
records.solution_text: To slow an object moving east, acceleration must point opposite the velocity. A change in velocity magnitude is acceleration.
records.solution_html: To slow an object moving east, acceleration must point opposite the velocity. A change in velocity magnitude is acceleration.

  1. Acceleration is zero whenever speed decreases.
  2. Velocity is east; acceleration is west. Acceleration is any change in velocity, including a decrease in speed.
  3. Velocity and acceleration are both east because the skateboarder is moving east.
  4. Velocity is west and acceleration is east because slowing reverses velocity instantly.

Velocity is west and acceleration is east because slowing reverses velocity instantly.
